analysis:
In November 2013 Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Kiran Kumar Reddy publicly opposed the bifurcation of the State, saying he was even prepared to step down to keep it united and that he would continue his fight against division while remaining in the Congress. The Hindu reported the remarks from public meetings at Chodavaram and Poduru.

The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill, 2014 was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 13 February 2014. The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 provided for the formation of Telangana from ten districts of the existing State, with Hyderabad as a common capital for ten years.

Telangana and the residual State of Andhra Pradesh were formed on 2 June 2014. The stated target of keeping the State united was not met.
notes: The exact quote is a paraphrase from The Hindu report; the YouTube link was found in search results and is a news clip titled 'Will do everything to stop bifurcation'. The Act PDF was listed in search results but not parsed as text.
